semantics: Reason codes are reconstructable protocol evidence. Registry membership defines recognized v1 reason identifiers but does not itself grant permission, execution authority, publication authority, or standards status.

reasons.description: A consequential transition lacks a required StegGate decision.
The consequence-time candidate does not match the admitted candidate binding.
Required policy-relevant evidence cannot be established safely enough to decide.
Downstream authority is broader than the admitted upstream authority.
Authority vocabularies cannot be compared under an admitted mapping.
Onward authority is improperly derived from a denied admission.
Required evidence origin or character classification is absent.
A later consequence lacks authority distinct from generation, acquisition, derivation, or processing.
The decision response violates its governed disclosure policy.
Input or output violates the declared stegverse.jcs.v1 canonicalization profile.
Claimed achieved assurance exceeds the independently observed level in at least one declared dimension.
A continuity relationship required for inheritance is not established.
Inheritance is claimed without the required lineage relationship.
Distinct continuity outcomes such as NOT_ESTABLISHED and INDETERMINATE were collapsed.
The presentation sink cannot be verified at the required assurance boundary.
The intended recipient is outside the effective presentation entitlement set.
A proposed derived presentation envelope broadens an inherited constraint.
A declared composition operator fails required algebraic properties.
Constraint vocabularies are incomparable without an admitted mapping.
Required transitive derivation provenance is partial or unknown under the profile.
A current source constraint required at decision time cannot be resolved.
Observed disclosure state is inconsistent with the consequence semantics.
A persistence target exposes the artifact to a readership broader than allowed.
A persistence path cannot preserve required derivation metadata.
Required sink exclusivity cannot be established.
Label or entitlement evidence is insufficient under the declared unlabeled posture.
StegCore and StegGate decision vocabularies cannot be projected losslessly.
A legacy ARA decision value is mapped inconsistently with the v4.6 decision vocabulary.
The consequence-time credential binding does not match the credential admitted with the execution request.
The requested action is outside the effective executable capability surface.
At least one requested action parameter exceeds the admitted capability bounds.
The execution path does not preserve the required governed-commit boundary.
